subject: Your place at {{college_name}} — {{course_title}}
body:
Dear {{first_name}},

I am pleased to offer you a place on {{course_title}} starting {{start_date}}.

Your learner reference is {{student_id}}. Please keep it — you will need it to enrol and to sign in to the learner portal.

To accept, reply to this email or call us on {{college_phone}} by {{reply_by}}. If your circumstances have changed, tell us anyway; we can usually find a course that fits.

Enrolment is on {{enrolment_date}}. Bring photo ID and evidence of your English and maths grades.

With best wishes,
{{college_name}} Admissions
